name: Version history
description: Saves versions of your vault with Git: automatic commits after you stop writing, one commit per agent turn, and `writer git:*` for agents. Local only: nothing is fetched or pushed.

memory.note: One sleeping thread that checks once a second; a status check runs in a short Rust call. The Rust part needs a restart to start or stop.

offNotes.agent.turn-started: Your pending edits won't be saved before an agent turn
offNotes.agent.turn-finished: Agent turns won't be saved in history
